sources.title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
sources.snippet: We're releasing AstaBrief, an 8B open-weights model for generating cited scientific reports, available in Asta's Fast mode or to download and run on your own infrastructure.

sources.title: Ai2 Releases AstaBrief 8B: Fast Open-Source Scientific Report…
sources.snippet: Overview The Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) has open-sourced "AstaBrief 8B", a high-speed report generation model for scientific research, along with its training data. This model is used as the "Fast mode" in the report generation feature of "Asta", an AI2 agent platform for scientific research.

sources.title: Ai2's AstaBrief 8B Writes Cited Research Reports 3.5x Faster in One ...
sources.snippet: AstaBrief 8B writes cited research reports in one pass Ai2, the Allen Institute for AI, has released AstaBrief 8B, an open-weight Qwen3-8B model fine-tuned to turn a research question and retrieved paper excerpts into a structured, cited report.
